name: YOTEL Singapore Orchard Road
detail: At first, finding the entrance was a bit inconvenient, but everything else about the hotel is comfortable. I knew the room size would be small, so it wasn't a concern, and the cleanliness and hygiene were good. Since we were three petite women, we used a room for three, which had a queen bed and a single bed above it. There is a safe, refrigerator, iron, hairdryer, electric kettle, and a water purifier connected to the sink. The bathroom had a rain shower and handheld showerhead, which was nice. For check-in and check-out, I had to use the computer personally, but the staff assists with it. However, it seems that the staff could do it much faster... There are plenty of elevators for quick movement, and the pool and breakfast restaurant are on the 10th floor. The pool is small. I had low expectations for breakfast as it was inexpensive, but I found it very good. The staff is incredibly friendly. When I requested towels, a robot came to deliver them. If you skip room cleaning, they give you a voucher for use in the hotel, but I didn't accept it. The location is excellent; the subway station is at Acharat Station, and the bus stop is in front of the Thai Embassy. The bus stop is about 50 meters away, making it very close, and you can take bus number 36 from the airport and get off at the Thai Embassy stop; the sign is clearly visible. If you're just looking to sleep at the hotel, it would be great to book when the price is low.

name: Park Avenue Rochester Hotel
detail: Convenient location, tidy and comfortable, and attentive service. The overall stay experience is quite good, with high cost performance, a convenient location, and hassle-free travel arrangements. The rooms and public areas are kept very clean, and the facilities are quite complete, meeting daily accommodation needs. The staff provides attentive service, communication is smooth, and the overall atmosphere is comfortable. In summary, the performance in various aspects is relatively balanced, making it a recommended accommodation choice.

name: Copthorne King's Hotel Singapore
detail: Taking the kids out, I wanted to choose a hotel that is convenient for transportation. Overall, it turned out to be quite good; there’s a bus stop right at the entrance and a subway station about 300 meters away. The breakfast is decent, but there aren't many options. The kids love the pool, which is very clean! The downside is that the rooms are not big; the two small beds are extremely small, to the point where you could fall off while turning over! The table in the room is too large and can easily bump into things! Initially, I was given a very noisy room, but after feedback, I was moved to a quiet room the next day, although I lost a box of chocolates in the process!

name: Carlton Hotel Singapore
detail: The location is excellent, just a ten-minute walk to the Merlion, and also very close to the museum and Fort Canning. When booking, we requested a non-interconnecting room, and the front desk provided us with a room facing the pool, which was very quiet. The overall space of the room is adequate and very clean, though the humidity is relatively high—this may be the reason why one of the blankets had a slight musty smell. We did not find any buttons for adjusting the dehumidification function on the air conditioning unit. The service attitude of the front desk and the transport staff was very good. Overall, it is worth the price, and I would still consider booking again when family comes to Singapore.

name: Gather House on 65 South Bridge Road
detail: นี่เป็นครั้งแรกในการนอนโฮสเทลของฉัน ที่นี่เป็นที่พักที่ดีมาก ราคาดี ห้องสะอาด มีสิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกดี ระบบเช็คอินมีภาษาของฉัน นอนสบาย ห้องน้ำสะอาด มีเครื่องซักผ้า พนักงานให้ความช่วยเหลือฉันเป็นอย่างดี และฉันได้พบกับเพื่อใหม่ที่ดีมากๆที่นี่

name: Aura Opera House Chinatown- Newly Renovated
detail: The hotel gives a very good first impression, with an overall warm and stylish atmosphere. The space is not extravagant, yet exudes elegance everywhere. The guest rooms are clean and comfortable, with a pleasant environment, and the check-in process is very smooth. The staff member Yang Ling is kind and polite, and the detailed service adds a sense of ease and enjoyment to the entire journey. It is worth the value, making it a delightful stay experience.

name: Hotel 1900 @ Chinatown
detail: The staff is very friendly. The facilities are clean and beautiful, possibly renewed. The bed is comfortable and the air conditioning works well. The shower is right above the toilet, and there is a sink next to it, so people with a good sense of cleanliness might find the floor concerning. It seems there was a Japanese person who brought a woman to their room in the middle of the night, and her moans were unpleasant.

name: ST Signature Tanjong Pagar
detail: You check in with your smartphone, and you also need your smartphone for the room key. You need to walk a little to the convenience store, 7-Eleven. The bed is small, but the shared spaces, toilets, and shower rooms are regularly cleaned. They are clean. There is a global multi-socket near the bed, which was helpful. I would like to use this hotel again next time because it is in a convenient location.

name: Straits Heritage Hostel
detail: I found this accommodation while searching for a place to stay during my solo layover trip! It’s not too far from the airport and is close to major tourist attractions in the city, so I was able to see most of the sights in just one night. Each bed has a partition and curtains, which made it very comfortable to sleep. However, if you are sensitive to snoring, it might be best to avoid this place. Also, the toilet and bathroom are separate and very clean, which I'm quite satisfied with!

name: V Hotel Lavender
detail: This was my third stay, and I stayed for five nights. Since it was the cheapest plan, my room had no city view and only had a window facing the room across. I was offered an upgrade for 50 SGD per night, but I decided to keep the current room. We are mostly out during the day, so if it's just a place to sleep, the direct access from Lavender Station makes it sufficient to spend time in a 14 square meter room even without a view. You can also take a bus directly to Chinatown, and if you walk behind the hotel, you can reach Mustafa Centre in about 15 minutes. There's also the Aperia Mall about a 5-minute walk towards Kallang, which has a food court and a Thai supermarket. Amenities included: Only bath towels, Shampoo and body soap, Toothbrush and slippers. Previously there were bottled water, but there is a water purifier in each room, which was fine to drink. However, since the windows do not open, there was a slight musty smell in the room, which might be concerning for some. The air conditioning was quite strong. The thickness of the shower was not an issue. The cleaning staff were always working in the hallway, so they quickly restocked any missing items. They seemed to enjoy their work with a cheerful attitude, which was pleasant! Thank you to everyone at the hotel! I would definitely like to stay again next time.
